Method of Attack: Exploiting Apache ActiveMQ remote code execution (RCE) vulnerability CVE-2023-46604 to breach networks and encrypt devices
Deploying ransomware binaries disguised as MSI files fetched from suspicious domains
Loading base64-encoded .NET DLL (EncDLL) to stop specific processes and encrypt files with RSACryptoServiceProvider
Impacted Systems: Apache ActiveMQ versions 5.15 to 5.18 including Legacy OpenWire Module versions
Attack Vector: Remote code execution via serialized class types in OpenWire protocol exploiting CVE-2023-46604
MSI files disguised as PNG images loaded via MSIExec
Indicators of Compromise: Java.exe running with Apache application as parent process
Remote binaries named M2.png and M4.png loaded via MSIExec
Log warnings in activemq.log about aborted transport connections
Presence of files or network communications associated with HelloKitty ransomware identified by specific domains and file hashes
